skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master project management terminology related to information systems projects.
Explain various forms and models of project management.
Implement stages of information systems projects including proposal, planning, execution, and closure.
Use necessary software tools to assist in managing information systems projects.
Develop proposals and plans for information systems projects effectively.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyze and Plan Information Systems Projects
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Develop skills in analyzing, planning, and executing information systems projects.
Possess the ability to self-study and read literature on project management.
Be able to work independently or actively participate in group activities.
Have the ability to organize group activities.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of information systems management.
